sut.name: TrainTicket
sut.repo: local fork of AsifShaafi/train-ticket-injection (branch MIST-trainticket kept local, not pushed; resolve to a public URL at artifact release)
sut.deploy: k8s/minikube via make deploy (with OTel->Jaeger tracing)

injection.trigger_input: valid Contacts with a fresh unique UUID id (and accountId, name, document fields)

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: With the flag on, addContact returns status:1 'create contacts success' but skips the persist POST to ts-contacts-service, so the contact is never saved. Verified by read-back: GET getAllContacts does not list the new contact id.

provenance.notes: Second lost-write positive on a different write-path service (target triple B; shows the oracle is not adminroute-specific). Read-back is COLLECTION membership by business key (accountId+documentNumber) -- adminbasic has NO per-entity GET, so no per-entity isolation advantage over adminroute (cold-review A). Status: build-verified only; read-back capture + traces pending Gate-1 (G0 smoke).
